matching_provenance.source_precedence: Later --extraction arguments replace earlier versions of the same collection/corpus. Ambiguous original IDs remaining within selected sources are excluded.
matching_provenance.transcript_rule: Unique strong multi-utterance text link; independent CHAT/verified legacy age within 0.1 months; compatible known target name; no raw ASR; original age <=96.
matching_provenance.utterance_rule: Same speaker code and role; identical casefolded lexical token sequence, allowing punctuation and known clitic-spacing differences; consume each historical occurrence at most once.
matching_provenance.repeated_utterances: Occurrence order within speaker/role/text key; no Cartesian join. This does not assert globally monotonic sequence alignment.
matching_provenance.parser_texts: UD reads original annotations; spaCy must parse text for same-surface control, and original_text separately for historical-gloss control.
matching_provenance.selection_note: This is a verified intersection subset, not the complete original corpus. Coverage is reported by age.

augmentation_rule: Exact case-insensitive NSUBJ to a non-VERB/AUX predicate, linked to each exact case-insensitive COP dependent of that predicate whose POS is VERB/AUX; no auxiliary, passive, progressive, conjunction, or inferred-subject bridges.
direct_pairing_policy: Emit every direct subject/copula combination sharing the same predicate index; multiplicity is counted and no subject or copula is inferred.
